K:
pacchāmukha：ပစ္ဆာမုခ（န）
[ပစ္ဆာ+မုခ]
（၁） မျက်နှာ၏နောက်၊ နောက်ဘက်၊ ကျောဘက်။ （တိ） （၂） နောက်သို့လှည့်သော မျက်နှာရှိသော၊ နောက်သို့-ရှေးရှု-ဦးတည်-သော （နောက်ပြန်）။ （၄） အနောက်အရပ်သို့ လှည့်သော မျက်နှာရှိသော၊ အနောက်အရပ်သို့-ရှေးရှု-မျက်နှာမူ-သော။

အနောက်သို့ မျက်နှာမူသည်။
DOP: 2 pacchā ind. [ S. paścāt; BHS paścā, pacchā, pacche], 1. later, after, afterwards; Vin II 63, 18 (yā āpattiyo pubbe chādesi tā āpattiyo ~ā na chādeti); 162, 24 (pure upasampannena ~ā upasampanno avandiyo); III 109, 1 (paṭhamaṃ bhikkhave rājā Licchavīhi pabhaggo atha rājā ~ā senaṃ saṅkaḍḍhitvā Licchaviyo parājesi); IV 229, 25 (bhikkhunī … ekikā ohīyitvā ~ā agamāsi); D I 8, 13 foll. (pure vacanīyaṃ ~ā avaca ~ā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca); 18, 18 (imaṃ mayaṃ hi addasāma idha paṭhamaṃ upapannaṃ mayaṃ pana amhā ~ā upapannā ti); 185, 21 foll. (saññā nu kho bhante paṭhamaṃ uppajjati ~ā ñāṇaṃ udāhu paṭhamaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjati ~ā saññā); M I 46, 10 (mā pamādattha mā ~ā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha); S I 50, 2* (~ā tapati dukkataṃ) = Dhp 314; S I 74, 12* (~ā ’saṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti vipāko hi ’ssa pāpako; Spk I 139, 18 : ~ā tesaṃ) ≠ Th 146 (~ā ’ssa); S I 141, 25* (na tassa ~ā na purattham atthi; Spk I 207, 19 : ~ā vuccati atītaṃ puratthaṃ vuccati anāgataṃ); Sn 773 (~ā pure vā pi apekhamānā; Nidd I 33, 10 : ~ā vuccati anāgataṃ pure vuccati atītaṃ); Pv 11:1 (purato va setena paleti hatthinā majjhe pana assatarīrathena ~ā ca kaññā sivikāya niyyati); Thī 508 (mā … baḷisaṃ gilitvā ~ā vihaññasi); Ja II 57, 30´ (daharakāle tāva kāme bhuñja bhutvāna ~ā mahallakakāle bhikkhassu); III 69, 15´ (yo hi dassāmī ti vatvā ~ā na dadāti); 382, 13* (anusāsitā me na bhaveyya ~ā); IV 101, 24* (dhammo have pāturahosi pubbe ~ā adhammo udapādi loke); Paṭis II 52, 10 (jhānaphassaṃ paṭhamaṃ phusati ~ā nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ sacchikarotī ti kāyasakkhī); Ap 32, 15 (~ā pabbajitvāna); Kv 351, 28 (paṭhamaṃ paṭhavī saṇṭhāti ~ā sattā uppajjantī ti); Mil 62, 31 (yathā mahārāja kaṃsathalaṃ ākoṭitaṃ ~ā anuravati anusandahati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se paccānuravati); 228, 8 (bhagavā … paṭhamaṃ tāva dānakathaṃ katheti ~ā sīlakathaṃ); Sv 1, 16* (aṭṭhakathā ādito vasisatehi pañcahi yā saṅgītā anusaṅgītā ca ~ā pi); Mp I 166, 12 (~ā pi jānissāmī ti); Pj II 360, 2 (~ā āgantvā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pacchāgantvā); Mhv 5:21 (jinanibbānato ~ā); — pacchā agamāsi in Ce, Ee at Ja I 285, 22 is prob. wr; Be, Se paccāgami); — pacchā gaccha in Ee, Se at Ja III 221, 21* is prob. wr for paccāgaccha ( Be, Ce so ); — pacchā gamī in Ee Pv-a 108, 8* is wr for paccāgami ( Be, Ce, Ee ); — pacchā jāto in Ee, Se at Ap 480, 16 and 497, 12 is prob. wr for paccājāto ( Be, Ce so ); — 2. behind; Ja IV 137, 25 (nāyaṃ maṅgalahatthī bhavituṃ anucchaviko, ~ā vāmanakadhātuko esa … bhūmiyaṃ patitvā pacchimapādehi vāmanakadhātuko jāto ti, Ee so; Be pādehi vāmanadhātuko; Ce pādehi vāmanakadhātuko; Se pacchāpādehi vāmanakadhātuko); Mhv 25:91 (rañño ~ā nisinno); Sadd 747, 21 (rathassa ~ā anurathaṃ); — 3. from or in the west; westwards; D III 192, 1* (puttadārā disā ~ā; or mfn. ) quoted Ja I 401, 6* ; — ° âbhimukha , mfn. , facing the west; Vin I 227, 18 (puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya ~ā nisīdiṃsu, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee pacchimābhimukhā) = D II 85, 10 ( Ee so; Be, Ce, Se pacchimābhimukhā) = Ud 86, 22 ( Ee so; Be, Ce, Se pacchimābhimukhā) ≠ D III 209, 3 ( Ee so; Be, Ce, Se pacchimābhimukhā); D II 220, 20 (Dhataraṭṭho mahārājā ~o nisinno hoti, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pacchimābhimukho; = 207, 22 : Be, Ce, Se pacchimābhimukho; Ee pacchāmukho); — see also pacchāmukha, pacchimābhimukha ( sv pacchima ); — °’ ātape , in the sun’s heat from the west; S V 216, 14 (bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ … ~e nisinno hoti piṭṭhiṃ otāpayamāno; Spk III 243, 23 foll.: pāsādacchāyāya puratthimaṃ disaṃ paṭicchannattā pāsādassa pacchimadisābhāge ātapo hoti); — °’- āsana , n. [pacchā + āsana 2 ], the rear seat (on an elephant); ( behind the withers; ?) Ja III 392, 7 (bodhisattaṃ ~e hatthipiṭṭhe nisīdāpetvā); V 287, 9 (rañño ~e rakkhā nāma icchitabbā ti, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se pacchimāsane); Pv-a 216, 12 (Ambasakkharo rājā hatthikkhandhavaragato … ~e nisinnassa purisassa … saññaṃ datvā, Be, Ce, Ee paccāsanne) ≠ 280, 3 ( Be, Ce, Ee paccāsanne); — °- kālaṃ , °- kāle , ind. [ cf S. lex. paścātkāle], at a time after, afterwards; Nidd-a I 374, 13 (pacchābhattan ti divābhattato ~aṃ; cf 374, 10 foll.: purekālaṃ accantasaṃyogatthe upayogavacanaṃ, atthato pana bhummam eva) ≠ Paṭis-a 132, 5 (~e); — °- gataka , mfn. , going afterwards; Ja VI 30, 8 ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se omit ); — °- gabbha , m. , a rear chamber; Dhp-a I 377, 23 (taṃ gahetvā ~e nisīdāpesuṃ); — °- geha , m. [pacchā + geha 1 ], (an area or shelter) behind the house; Dhp-a I 402, 11 (~aṃ agamāsi); III 333, 18 (~e ṭhito goṇo); — °- jātā in Ee, Se at Pp-a 208, 1 is wr for paccājātā ( Be, Ce so ); — °- jāto in Ee at Peṭ 214, 12 is wr for paccājāto ( Be so ); — °- ñattiṭṭhapana , n. , placing the motion afterwards; Kkh 2 30, 28 ; 31, 7 ; — °- tāpa , m. [ S. paścāttāpa], remorse, regret; Abh 169; — °- ninna , mfn. , tending towards the west; S IV 191, 11 (gaṅgā nadī bhante pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā sā na sukarā ~aṃ kātuṃ °-poṇaṃ °-pabbhāraṃ); V 53, 7 ; — °- nipātana , n. , lying down after or later; — ifc see pubbuṭṭhāna- ( sv pubba 2 ); — °- nipāti(n) , mfn. , lying down after or later; falling or placed after (in a cpd); Vin I 346, 18 (Dīghāvukumāro … Kāsirañño pubbuṭṭhāyī ahosi ~ī); D II 176, 1 (~inī); III 191, 7 (pubbuṭṭhāyino ca honti ~ino ca); A III 37, 20 (bhavissāma pubbuṭṭhāyiniyo ~iniyo; Mp III 246, 16 : sabbapacchā nipajjanasīlā); Sv 168, 19 foll.; Sadd 924, 24 (varasaddo ~ī … rājavaro); — °- nivesana , n. , behind the house; Dhp-a I 126, 2 (~e vajaṃ viya ekaṃ ṭhānaṃ parikkhipitvā); — °- pabbhāra , mfn. , bending, heading, towards the west; S IV 191, 12 ; — °- pāda , m. , 1. a hind leg; Ja III 373, 25´ (aparapādesū ti ~esu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee omits ); — 2. the back of a foot; ? Ja III 438, 3 (coraṃ dvīsu ~esu gahetvā, Be so; Ce, Ee °-bhāgesu; Se °-bāhāsu); — °- poṇa , mfn. [pacchā + poṇa 2 ], inclining, moving, towards the west; S IV 191, 11 ; — °- bandha , °-baddha, m. , a large oar used as a rudder; ? a dinghy; ? Abh 666 (~o goṭaviso); Ja VI 226, 1´ foll. (goṭaviso vuccati ~o, yathā nāvāya ~o nāvam eva anugacchati tathā ime sattā niyatam eva anugacchantī ti vadati, Be, Ce so; Ee pacchimabandho; Se vuccati pacchimabandhā nāvā, yathā khuddakanāvā mahānāvāya pacchimabandhā mahānāvam eva anugacchati …); Mp I 182, 11 (so kañcanamahānāvāya ~o viya satthu padānupadikaṃ anugañchi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee °-baddho) = Th-a III 134, 30 ( Ce so; Be, Ee, Se °-baddho) = Ap-a 264, 24 ( Be, Se °-baddho; Ce, Ee °-baddho viya satthāraṃ … anugacchati); — nippacchābandha, mfn. , without a following dinghy; ? without a rudder; ? Ps III 6, 7 (yūthā vissaṭṭhasīho viya nippacchābandhā mahānāvā viya gamanādisu ekavihārino … viharantī ti, Se so; Be nipacchābandhamahānāvā; Ce nippaccābandha-; Ee nippacchābandha-); — °- bāhaṃ , °- bāhuṃ , adv. , with arms tied behind one’s back; Vin I 344, 19 (daḷhāya rajjuyā ~aṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā) ≠ D III 67, 16 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~uṃ); D I 245, 10 (daḷhāya anduyā ~aṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ baddho); Ja I 440, 9 (abandhitabbayuttakā paṇḍitā ~aṃ baddhā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~uṃ); V 310, 30´ (tesaṃ yeva uttarisāṭakena ~aṃ bandhitvā); Pv-a 4, 19 (nagaraguttiko taṃ … ~aṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhāpetvā, Be, Ce, Ee ~uṃ); — °- bhaṭṭha , ( mf ) n. , see padapaccābhaṭṭha ( sv pada 1 ); — °- bhatta , n. , later or further food; Vism 61, 1 (pavāritena satā pacchā laddhaṃ bhattaṃ ~aṃ nāma); — °- bhattaṃ , °- bhatte , ind. [ cf BHS paścādbhakta, paścābhakta], after the midday meal; in the afternoon; Vin III 53, 7 (purebhattaṃ vā ~aṃ vā rattiṃ vā divā vā); D I 71, 18 (so ~aṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto; Sv 210, 17 : bhattassa pacchato); Ja IV 180, 19 (eko ~aṃ pañcacattālīsayojanamaggaṃ gantvā, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se ~e) ≠ Ps II 136, 15 (ekasmiṃ ~e); Paṭis I 30, 29 (purebhattaṃ pi āsevati ~aṃ pi āsevati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee omits; Paṭis-a 132, 5 : divābhattato pacchākāle); Vism 430, 21 (purebhatte gahitaṃ dadhirasaṃ hoti ~e pākatika-udakam eva); Sp 1095, 13 (gilānassa ~aṃ guḷaṃ anujānāmī ti); Spk I 75, 5 (brahmabhavanaṃ … ~e bhattagehaṃ viya suññataṃ addasaṃsu); Dhp-a IV 195, 1 (~e gandhamālādihatthaṃ mahājanaṃ … disvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~aṃ); Pj II 346, 30 (Piṇḍolabhāradvājo ~aṃ divāvihāratthāya Udenassa uyyānam eva gacchati); Kkh 2 319, 1 (~an ti majjhanhike vītivatte yāva suriyassa atthaṅgamā); Mhv 5:216 (thero … sappi-atthaṃ ca caraṇaṃ ~aṃ paṭikkhipi); — °- bhattato , ind. , from after the midday meal; Sp 710, 17 (~ato paṭṭhāya sattāhaṃ nirāmisaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ); Ud-a 403, 14 ; Kkh 2 132, 8 ; — °- bhattika , m ( fn )., one who eats further food; Vism 61, 4 (pacchābhattaṃ sīlaṃ assā ti ~o, na ~o khalupacchābhattiko); — ifc see khalu-; — °- bhāga , m. , the hind or back part, the rear; the area behind; the later or further part; a later time; Ja I 72, 21 (mayaṃ sammukhā yuddhaṃ dātuṃ na sakkhissāma ~ena dassāmā ti); III 322, 28 (sīhaṃ … ~e vijjhi); 438, 3 (coraṃ dvīsu ~esu gahetvā, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be °-pādesu; Se °-bāhāsu); V 131, 6 foll. (purimabhāgena saraṃ khipitvā ~ena nikkhamāpesi ~ena saraṃ khipitvā purimabhāgena nikkhamāpesi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pacchimabhāgena nikkhāmesi, ~e khipitvā …); VI 103, 27 (rathaṃ nivattetvā sīhapañjarummāre ~ena ṭhapetvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~aṃ); Sp 498, 18 (musā bhaṇissan ti pubbabhāgo atthi musā mayā bhaṇitan ti ~o natthi); Sv 373, 28 (pitugharamajjhena kira gantvā ~e puttassa gharaṃ hoti); 564, 29 (hatthināgo ~aṃ apaloketukāmo); 654, 2 (pañcahatthisatāni āsanānaṃ ~e ṭhapetvā); Spk II 284, 4 (sarīrassa ~aṃ ākaḍḍhitvā); Mp II 248, 14 (~ena āgantvā); Dhp-a I 407, 1 (~e puttaṃ labhitvā); III 94, 4 (dānato pubbe dānakāle ~e ti tīsu kālesu); IV 146, 8 (~ena gantvā piṭṭhipassena mahantaṃ pāṇippahāraṃ adāsi); Pv-a 114, 3 (imaṃ yakkhaṃ … yāne ~aṃ bandhitvā, Ce, Ee °-bāhaṃ); — °- bhāva , m. , a further existence; existence afterwards; Sp 133, 8 (tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā honti yathā nesaṃ ~o na hoti tathā katā honti) ≠ Mp IV 79, 6 ; Nidd-a I 245, 2 (na paccāgacchatī ti na ~en’ āgacchati, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se paccabhave nāgacchati); — °- bhūma , °-bhumma, n. and mfn. [pacchā + bhumma 2 ], the western district; belonging to the western district; S III 5, 26 (icchāma … ~aṃ janapadaṃ gantuṃ); — ~-gamika, mfn. , intending to go to (a place in) the western district; S III 5, 22 (sambahulā ~-gamikā bhikkhū, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ~-gāmikā; Spk II 256, 9 : ~-gamikā ti ~aṃ aparadisāya niviṭṭhaṃ janapadaṃ gantukāmā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pacchābhummagamikā ti pacchābhummaṃ); — °- bhūmaka , °-bhūmika, mfn. , living in the west; S IV 312, 5 (brāhmaṇā … ~ā … mataṃ kālakataṃ uyyāpenti nāma; Spk III 104, 5 : °-bhūmivāsino); A V 263, 8 (Mp V 74, 22 : ~ā ti °-bhūmivāsikā, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se °-bhūmikā ti); — °- mukha , mfn. [ BHS paścānmukha], 1. facing the west; going westward; D II 207, 22 (Dhataraṭṭho mahārājā ~o nisinno hoti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se pacchimābhimukho; = 220, 20 : Be pacchimābhimukho; Ce, Ee, Se pacchābhimukho); M I 354, 20 (puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya ~ā nisīdiṃsu, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pacchimābhimukhā) ≠ S IV 183, 25 ( Ee, Se so; Be, Ce pacchimābhimukhā); M III 5, 16 (so … ummaggaṃ gahetvā ~o gaccheyya); Th 529 (passantu taṃ Sākiyā Koḷiyā ca ~aṃ Rohiṇiyaṃ tarantaṃ); Ja IV 334, 7 (~o nisinno, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pacchimābhimukho); Dhp-a III 155, 4 (pācīnaninnāya gaṅgāya … ~-karaṇaṃ); — 2. facing backwards; looking back; directed backwards; Ja IV 348, 22 (tacchasūkaro parivattitvā ~o); Sv 425, 21 (paṭisandhito paṭṭhāya ~aṃ ñāṇaṃ pesetvā); Ps III 81, 1 (tassa mukhaṃ parivattitvā ~aṃ jātaṃ); — °- mukhe , ind. , behind one’s head; ? Ja IV 182, 2 (~e kese bandhitvā); — °- vatthu , n. , the ground behind (the house); Nidd I 11, 4 (purevatthu ~u; Nidd-a I 54, 22 : pacchā ti gharassa pacchā); Pv-a 88, 6 (ito gehassa ~uto mā tāva agamāsī ti); — °- samaṇa , m. [ BHS paścācchramaṇa], an accompanying bhikkhu; one who walks behind an elder (in attendance); Vin I 46, 15 (sace upajjhāyo ~aṃ ākaṅkhati); 294, 33 (bhagavā āyasmatā Ānandena ~ena senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto); II 32, 16 (na bhikkhave parivāsikena bhikkhunā pakatattassa bhikkhuno puresamaṇena vā ~ena vā kulāni upasaṅkamitabbāni); M II 100, 13 (bhagavā āyasmatā Aṅgulimālena ~ena … cārikaṃ pakkāmi; Ps III 334, 23 : bhaṇḍaggāhakena ~ena); S I 188, 10 (āyasmā Ānando … Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi āyasmatā Vaṅgīsena ~ena); A III 137, 5 foll. (pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ~o na ādātabbo); Ja III 56, 16 (~aṃ ādāya tassa gharadvāraṃ gantvā); Mil 15, 24 (āyasmā Assagutto … āyasmatā Nāgasenena saddhiṃ ~ena); Spk III 26, 16 (aññataro vuḍḍhapabbajito pi therassa ~o viya hutvā anubandhanto pāvisi); Mp I 404, 8 (satthā Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ ~aṃ katvā tassa gharaṃ gantvā); — apacchāsamaṇa, mfn. , without an attendant; Th-a III 69, 5 ; — apacchā , ind. , not after, not later, not afterwards; — apure apacchā, apacchā apure ( or cpd ), apacchā apurimaṃ ( or cpd ), neither before nor after, simultaneously; Ja III 295, 9 (bodhisattassa patanaṃ ca … kākassa … ure nilīyanaṃ ca ~ā apurimaṃ ahosi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee apacchāpurimaṃ); Sp 1168, 23 (sace dve pi ~ā apurimaṃ nipajjanti, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce apacchāpurimaṃ); Mp I 37, 7 (~ā apurimaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee apacchāpurimaṃ); 275, 3 (sabbakesānaṃ pana oropanaṃ ca arahattaphalasacchikiriyā ca ~ā apure ahosi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee apacchāpure) = Th-a I 43, 31 = Ap-a 523, 32 ( eds apure ~ā) ≠ Th-a I 148, 15 ( eds ~ā apurimā); Mp IV 6, 15 (apubbaṃ acariman ti apure ~ā ekakkhaṇe yeva); Vibh-a 21, 20 (paṭisandhikkhaṇe pañcakkhandhā ~ā apure ekato pātubhavanti); — apacchāvattana, n. [ cf S. paścādvartin], not remaining; not following after; Dhp-a I 310, 2 (kilesānaṃ apacchāvattanato, na hi taṃ kilesā anubandhanti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se apaccāvattanato); — atipacchā , ind. , too much behind, too much to the back; Sp 129, 15 (cha nisajjadose vajjetvā … atidūraṃ accāsannaṃ … atisammukhaṃ ~ā ti … ~ā nisinno sace daṭṭhukāmo hoti gīvaṃ pasāretvā daṭṭhabbaṃ hoti) = Sv 484, 4 foll.; — see also pacchato.
